title: Modular project configuration
description: Project-local policy for Modular repository scans. Network and browser audits remain CLI-only opt-ins.

failOn.description: Fail with exit code 3 when an unsuppressed finding at or above this severity exists.

failOnNew.description: Fail with exit code 3 only for unsuppressed baseline-new findings at or above this severity. Requires baseline.

ignore.description: Exact directory names to exclude wherever they occur.

outputFormats.description: Additional machine-readable artifacts written beside the Markdown reports.

rule.description: Finding rule id glob, for example security.secret-* or site.meta-description.

expires.description: Optional last valid date; expired entries automatically stop suppressing.

failOnRegression.description: Gate new findings or increased severity against a required baseline.

failOnIncomplete.description: Exit 1 when discovered source files could not be fully inspected.
